meta.author: Sudan Geopolitical Analyst
meta.targets: data/eras/*.json economy_en (Historian-owned, READ ONLY; no edits)
meta.scope: Economic figures in modern eras (1820+), as in db/second_sources_for_historian.json. Pre-1820 GHA figures and the war era's food/displacement figures (covered in db/war_refresh_un_cites.json) are excluded. The 1984–85 famine death estimate is a fatality figure and is excluded.
meta.rules: KEEP = matches, with a quote; MISMATCH = other figure quoted, no winner picked; NO-SECOND-SOURCE = none read in full. No rewording.
not_fetchable: IMF REO MCD Apr 2024 PDF (Access Denied / timeout)
